Installation isn't included in the price. Four-post parking lifts and scissor lifts are usually assembled by the owner in an afternoon with two people. Two-post lifts anchor into concrete (most call for 4" of 3,000-psi, cured 28 days — see the manual for your model) and most need a 220V single-phase circuit; we recommend a professional for those. We bolted down our own, so we can tell you what it takes, or connect you with an installer in southeast Wisconsin — ask before you order and we'll quote it with the lift.

About certification. Forward lifts and the AMGO OH-10 ALI are ALI certified. Other AMGO models are CE certified. If your shop is subject to inspection or insurance requirements that call for ALI, choose a certified model or ask.
